sample_unit: procedure-specific patient information leaflets (ChatGPT vs BOFAS) for three foot and ankle procedures

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-generated patient leaflets versus BOFAS leaflets (FKRE, FKGL, GFS, SMOG)
links.effect: FKRE -40.4 (SD 7.69) for AI vs 91.9 (SD 2.24) for BOFAS (p ≤ 0.0001); FKGL 11.7 vs 1.1; GFS 14.46 vs 2.0; SMOG 11.0 vs 3.06.
links.quote: PILs produced by AI had significantly lower FKRE scores when compared to BOFAS -40.4 (SD: ±7.69) compared to 91.9 (SD: ±2.24) (p ≤ 0.0001), indicating poor readability of AI-generated text.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated patient information leaflets
links.effect: Required grade level of AI responses consistently higher than leaflets: FKGL 11.7 vs 1.1 (p ≤ 0.0001).
links.quote: FKGL scoring indicated that the required grade of students to understand AI responses was consistently higher than compared to information leaflets at 11.7 versus 1.1 (p ≤ 0.0001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing ChatGPT-generated patient information leaflets with professional society leaflets for foot and ankle surgery across readability scores and DISCERN quality criteria, without testing a specific implementation safeguard or practice.
